import ctypes,errno,json,os
libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
libc.tmpfile.restype=ctypes.c_void_p
libc.fclose.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]
p=libc.tmpfile(); error=ctypes.get_errno()
if p: libc.fclose(p)
print(json.dumps({"tmpfile_opened":bool(p),"errno":error,"error":os.strerror(error),"TMPDIR":os.environ["TMPDIR"],"tmp_read_only":bool(os.statvfs("/tmp").f_flag & os.ST_RDONLY)}))
assert not p and error==errno.EROFS
